groups.title: Database
groups.intro: JEH creates and migrates its own tables on start. Pick the dialect before the first run; changing it later means migrating the data yourself.

groups.title: Web server
groups.intro: Where the HTTP server listens and how users reach it. Set `web_host` to the URL users type: redirect URIs, webhook targets, and links in notifications are built from it.

groups.title: Paths and storage
groups.intro: Directories JEH writes to. Everything here except the database is a cache that can be recreated.

groups.title: Encryption
groups.intro: Keys that protect stored secrets. Back them up separately from the database: the database is unreadable without them.

groups.title: Authentication
groups.intro: How users sign in. See [Authentication](../configuration.md) for the provider-side setup.

groups.title: Tasks
groups.intro: Concurrency, retention, and the environment task processes run in.

groups.title: Runners
groups.intro: Server-side switches first, then the keys a runner reads from its own configuration file. See [Runners](../configuration.md).

groups.title: Task JWT
groups.intro: Short-lived tokens that identify a task to external systems. See [Task JWTs](../configuration.md).

groups.title: Logging and metrics
groups.intro: Where server, event, and task logs go, and the Prometheus endpoint. See [Logs](../configuration.md) and [Metrics](../configuration.md).

groups.title: Teams and invitations
groups.intro: How people are added to projects. See [Teams](../configuration.md).

groups.title: Subscription
groups.intro: Upstream subscription interface options. Proprietary implementations are not included in JEH. See [feature scope](../configuration.md#feature-scope).

groups.title: High availability
groups.intro: Running several nodes against one database. See [High availability](../configuration.md).

groups.title: Audit log
groups.intro: Recording who did what in JEH, and sending the events to a SIEM. See [Audit log](../configuration.md).

groups.title: Debugging
groups.intro: Switches useful when diagnosing a problem. Do not leave them on in production.
